sets.name: Faction Wars
sets.description: The original roster: Digi-Destined partners, Tamers, Savers, Frontier and Xros Wars lines, with Royal Knights and Demon Lords at 5 cost. Hyper Roll rules and Data Wisps.

sets.name: Galaxies
sets.description: TFT Set 3 on Digimon: DigiDestined, Dark Area, DigiXros fusions and Data Pirates. Every game rolls one Galaxy, a rule that changes the game for every Tamer.

sets.name: Fates
sets.description: Partner Digimon: some shop slots offer a Champion-form Partner whose marked trait counts double. One Partner at a time. Hyper Roll rules, Digi-Forge artifacts.

sets.name: Reckoning
sets.description: The Dark Spore spreads: Shadow items trade a drawback for power, and the Radiant Blessing lifts Tamers who fall low. Hyper Roll rules.

sets.name: Gizmos & Gadgets
sets.description: Inventors, pirates and Dark Masters in a gadget city. Three Digivice upgrades per game in Silver, Gold and Prismatic, with the tiers shown in advance by Hextech Gates.

sets.name: Dragonlands
sets.description: Mega Dragons that take two team slots, a Treasure Dragon round, Golden Armor gold items and fixed augment rounds with one reroll. Hyper Roll rules.

sets.name: Into the Arcane
sets.description: Kowloon gangs, the Bagra Army, DigiPolice and the Rebels. At 4-3 you mutate one Digimon with an Anomaly; Syndicate Digimon trade Shimmer at the black market. Hyper Roll rules.

sets.name: K.O. Coliseum
sets.description: A Digimon fighting tournament. Feed Digi-Cores to pick digivolution paths, choose Justimon's arm and Labramon's partner, and bank gems with Jewel Gambit. Plays at Hyper Roll or Normal pace.

sets.name: Undermons
sets.description: Undermons: 26 alliances, tiered items with no recipes, creep rounds, and a Tamer on your board from round 10 who ranks up every 5 rounds.

sets.name: Undermons Knockout
sets.description: Undermons Knockout: 4 lives, 2 copies digivolve, a starter crew, an item every other round and a Tamer from round 2. About 10 minutes.

sets.name: Auto Chess
sets.description: Auto Chess: races and classes, 2-copy Druids, Wizards, creep loot, interest and XP.

sets.name: Template
sets.description: A small test set that shows every part of the set format.
